deletion_how: In-app NEW HIVE (RITE → SAVE), or uninstall, or clear app storage.
notes: Save game is localStorage / app private storage only. Not uploaded. No ads, no analytics SDK. In-app purchases are processed by Google Play Billing; the app only asks Play which heroes the player owns and caches that list on the device (nidus.owned.v1). Nothing is sent to the developer.
